title: Turtle Trinket Jar (2 parts)
description: A little turtle whose hex-pattern shell lifts off to reveal a hollow body for small treasures: beads, buttons, coins, earrings, LEGO-size bits.
use: Trinket jar / small-parts dish on a desk or dresser. Not food safe unless you use a food-safe filament and liner.
material: PLA or PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 3 perimeters. Print base and lid as laid out. Lid lip fits with 0.25 mm radial clearance (loose slip fit, no glue).
fit_notes: Lid lip 0.25 mm radial clearance to base bore (slip fit). Interior cavity ~61 mm dia x 20 mm deep.
